_variants_note: drop_narrative is a byte-for-byte no-op on all 3 checkpoints (no narrative markers), so reorder_list_items replaces it; changed before any live run.
_control_note: Q5 per subject is a CONTROL: its answer is in the document's tail (verified absent from truncated_50.md). The truncated variant must lose it; otherwise the instrument cannot see information loss and the run is INSTRUMENT_INVALID. D1-D4/P1-P4/B1-B4 answers all survive truncation (verified), so truncation is not expected to hurt them. Control oracle = literal document content, not git.
_regex_rule: oracle regex =   + re.escape(accept without leading '#') +   (control answers: escaped literal, no  )
